_doc: The edit. Per scene: a list of sub-cuts, played in order. clip = file in footage/ without .mp4 (default: the scene id); in/out = seconds of that clip; crop = [x, y, w, h] punch-in on the 1920x1080 source; blur = [x, y, w, h] smears that region of the source; mask = "readout" finds the yellow wheel-drag box in this cut and paints out its size badges and key hint as they move (unused since the takes hide them); line = index of the scene's line this cut starts under, or [line, part] for a part of a split line (cuts that follow share the time up to the next placed cut and are stretched together to fill it); start = seconds into the scene where this cut starts, instead of line; sub = "top" moves the subtitle to the top during this cut; speed = fix this cut's speed instead of stretching it. _target overrides a scene's target seconds from script.json (never below its speech); _tight lists scenes cut to the length of their speech; _at gives a scene's line start times by hand, one per line, and a list for a line splits it at its punctuation into that many parts, each with its own start (null = where the voice puts it). note = {text, point: [x, y], from: left|right|up|down, after: s} draws a yellow caption with an arrow to that point during the cut; struck = {text, over: [x, y, w, h], after: s} draws red struck-through text above that rect. v7: no crop anywhere (whole screen), every cut placed by start + speed.
